hook_en: You don't have to carry it alone. 🙏
reflect_en: Start this week by handing God what you've been holding. He doesn't just take the burden; He promises to sustain you, and you can say with David: I will trust in You.
q_en: What burden do you need to cast on the LORD this week?
x_en: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
tiktok: Cast your burden on the LORD 🙏 Psalm 55:22–23 — He will sustain you this week
yt_title: Cast Your Burden Upon the LORD | Psalm 55:22–23 #Shorts
li_open: Leaders carry a lot that no one else sees.
li_quote: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you… But I will trust in You.
li_body: David wrote this in a season of betrayal and pressure, and his answer was to hand the weight to God. Leaders who cast their burdens on the LORD, and make room for the people they serve to do the same in prayer, can start a heavy week sustained instead of crushed.
reflect_es: Comienza esta semana entregándole a Dios lo que has estado cargando. Él promete sustentarte, y tú puedes decir con David: yo confiaré en ti.
q_es: ¿Qué carga necesitas echar sobre Jehová esta semana?
x_es: Echa sobre Jehová tu carga, y él te sustentará; no dejará para siempre caído al justo.
key_en: Cast your burden upon the LORD
